name: Kokonoe Kasumi
source:
"I'm no longer part of the Kokonoe family. We were a branch of the family in the first place so now that my parents aren't here anymore, I was basically abandonned by my relatives."

—A former lady of a noble house living a tumultuous life full of drama.

She was a daughter of a noble family, but her parents passed away after their family's financial affairs went bankrupt, leaving her behind to pay their debts. In order to pay those off, she is now working as a waitress at a café she was introduced to called "Matsuyotei". Her professional name is Sakura. She was betrothed to her childhood friend Utashiro Tobari, but the engagement has been terminated due to her circumstances.

[Translated from the [url=https://senju131313.wixsite.com/fukanagigame/post/deitsuagame]official website[/url]]
